title: One normal post is pushed to followers' lists, one star post is pulled and merged at read time
captions: Asha has a few hundred followers. When she posts, the app saves post 57 once and puts one small job on a queue: fan out post 57.

Workers read Asha's follower list. They add the ID 57 to the top of each active follower's list in the cache. Each list is capped, so the oldest ID falls off the end. Li has been away, so the workers skip her.
Star has 30 million followers. Pushing her post would mean 30 million writes. So her posts are not fanned out. Post 58 is saved once, in Star's own list of posts.
Ravi opens the app. The server reads his ready-made list and the latest posts of the few stars he follows. It merges them by time or by score. One cache read plus a few small pulls.
Li comes back after a month. Her list is gone from the cache. The server looks up who she follows, reads their recent posts from the database, and builds her list again.
